title: Resuming a finished reviewer is refused, and the refusal says to send a fresh reviewer the prior report
why: A SendMessage resume of a finished reviewer runs with no worktree and on the parent's model. Rule roles-resume-by-name says to send a fresh reviewer the prior report instead. Three incidents on Nov 7.
note: Topic guards. No earlier step held it (resume-lost-worktree covers a top-level session). Filed 20:30 CST Nov 7. Widening sighting (lane other-checkout-cp-own (session_013NEJL3R2CBFavz7grtbJY8); coordinator, 04:13 CST Nov 8): a resumed builder or test-author whose isolation worktree was reaped stops at worktree-home too; rule roles-resume-by-name names only the reviewer case.
